text: Did the weekly tally this morning and we are four boxes light on the B-lot pallet compared with what the system says we hold.
Numbers on the shelf don't add up. Paper register says 120, I counted 112 twice with a colleague.
After last Friday's issue the balance should have dropped by 10 but the computer shows it dropped by 18. Something was booked out twice or taken.
Returned items from the range never made it back onto the books, so the store looks overstocked on paper and short in reality.
Stocktake variance again on the same lot as last month, about 3 percent under.
It has been sweltering inside magazine 2 since the cooling unit died, the thermometer by the door says 38.
Moisture is getting in somewhere, the cardboard on the bottom row has gone soft and there is a musty smell.
Logger graph for bay 7 shows relative humidity sitting near 90 all weekend, way above what we are allowed.
Water pooled near the racks after the storm and the air inside feels wet.
The bay is freezing overnight now that the heater is off, readings below the minimum on three nights.
Half the crates from the new delivery have stickers peeling off and you cannot read the lot code any more.
Tamper seals on two containers were already cut when we opened the shipment for inspection.
Box says one lot, the paperwork inside says another, and the barcode scans as a third.
Outer cartons are split at the corners and the inner liners are torn.
Hazard markings are missing from the side panels of the latest batch.
Nobody signed for the handover when the items moved between stores on Tuesday, there is just a blank space on the form.
I can't find any record of who held the lot between the 3rd and the 9th.
The transfer voucher was filled in after the fact and the times don't match the gate log.
Receipt slip for the return is missing so we cannot prove it came back.
Two different officers are named as the custodian for the same period in two different registers.
Came in at 6am and the magazine gate was wide open, padlock hanging off, nothing in the entry book.
A contractor was walking around inside the restricted area by himself with nobody escorting him.
Badge logs show someone swiping into the store at 2am on a day it was closed.
Scratch marks and a bent hasp on the side door suggest someone tried to pry it.
A keycard belonging to an officer who left last month opened the vault yesterday.
The team moved the pallets with only one person present even though the rules need two.
Someone was vaping right next to the loading bay during the transfer.
They skipped the pre-move briefing and nobody wore the required protective gear.
The fire point near the magazine had no extinguisher while work was going on.
Mobile phones were being used inside the handling area against standing orders.
The six-monthly check on this batch should have been done in April and it still hasn't happened.
No one has inspected bay 3 since last year according to the inspection card on the door.
Several lots are past their review date but still marked as fit for issue.
Surveillance testing schedule has slipped by two months for the whole magazine.
The due date for the condition check passed weeks ago and nothing is booked.
The truck hit a pothole hard on the way in and three crates came off the stack and split open.
Forklift driver clipped the rack while unloading and dented two containers.
Load wasn't strapped properly for the convoy and arrived all shifted with crushed boxes.
A pallet was dropped off the tail lift during delivery this afternoon.
Containers arrived scraped and gouged after being dragged across the yard.
The extractor fan in the store makes a horrible rattling noise and keeps cutting out.
Half the lights in magazine 1 are dead and the emergency lighting didn't come on in the power cut.
The alarm panel keeps beeping with a fault code and maintenance haven't come out.
Roof is leaking through the ceiling tiles above the walkway.
The loading dock door motor is broken so we are lifting it by hand.
My manager keeps putting me on every night shift and won't explain why when I ask.
I raised a concern three weeks ago and have heard absolutely nothing back.
The way leave gets approved here feels like favouritism.
I was shouted at in front of the whole team during the morning brief.
My earlier complaint was closed without anyone speaking to me about it.
